findings.title: `Kysely` and `DB` are used as types but no import was added for them.
findings.body:
The new `let db: Kysely<DB>;` names the `Kysely` and `DB` types. The CHANGES block counts exactly 36 added lines in this file, and all of them are in the two hunks shown, so no import was added. Before this change, `db` was a `const` whose type was inferred from `getKyselyDB()`, so the file had no reason to import these types already (I could not see the file's import list to confirm).

If they are not imported, `tsc`/`npm run check` fails with "Cannot find name 'Kysely'/'DB'". Vitest may still run, because it strips types without checking them.

Fix: add `import { Kysely } from 'kysely';` and `import { DB } from 'src/schema';` (or the project's DB type path). Alternatively, type the variable as `Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getKyselyDB>>`.
